top_signals.title: Stocks Drop as Oil Rally Fuels Treasury Volatility: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A renewed episode of bond volatility left traders unwilling to make riskier bets, with stocks falling on worries that elevated oil prices will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to lift rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Kyiv internet providers report major outages after Russian attacks damage data centers
top_signals.summary: At least four internet providers serving Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine suffered partial connectivity losses following Wednesday’s drone attack, according to internet monitoring group NetBlocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
